description: This file defines a Java class 'SshFtpClient' implementing basic SSH-based FTP client operations such as connect, copy, list, and close connection, using the Apache OFBiz framework components and Apache SSHD library.

classes.name: SshFtpClient
classes.description: A client class for connecting via SSH to an SFTP server, capable of copying files, listing directory contents, and closing connections.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes an SSH session and connects to the SFTP server with provided hostname, username, password, port, and timeout.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies data from an InputStream to a specified path and filename on the SFTP server.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists files in the specified directory on the SFTP server.

methods.name: setBinaryTransfer
methods.description: Stub method for setting binary transfer mode (not implemented).

methods.name: setPassiveMode
methods.description: Stub method for setting passive mode (not implemented).

methods.name: closeConnection
methods.description: Closes the SFTP connection and SSH session.
